next word of the same divide routine (read at 0x3be9) - a number
read as `mov cx, word cs:[0x3472]; sub cx, 1; ... jne` (0x36db) - a loop counter, not a pointer
0xffff stack-pointer sentinel; written as `mov word [dseg_0c7e], sp` (0x4668)

immediate_pointers.note: `mov bx, 0x33b3`: the nibble table leaf_loc_OHGP translates through with `cs xlatb` (0x3254). Handed in bx to leaf_loc_TTKL, which reaches that `cs xlatb` only past a conditional jump, so the automatic scan stops short
`mov bx, 0x33b3; add bx, word [bp + 0xc]; mov word [cs:bx], 0xff` (0x3210): an entry of the same 0x32b3 table, indexed by an argument the scan cannot prove is an index
`mov si, 0x2602`: the four 0x100-byte plane buffers at 0x2502 that io_loc_QMLN adds to si (0x2f7a). si is overwritten by `xor si, si` (0x2cb2) before any read
`add si, 0x2602`: the caller passes si = plane * 0x100 (0x2cb2-0x2cc9) and sets DS = CS (0x2cb0); the sum is read as `mov al, byte [si]` (0x2fa8)

`add di, 0x24fd` after `mul bx; mov di, ax`: a row of the 0x80-byte mask buffer at 0x23fd (filled at 0x2d2a), later written by `rep movsb` under ES = CS (0x2dbc). The `inc di` loop's backward jump ends the automatic scan
`mov bx, 0x257d`: the scratch row at 0x247d, built with `mov byte [bx], ah` (0x2d8e, DS = CS since 0x2d28) and copied out of as `mov si, cseg_247d` (0x2db6). A backward jump ends the automatic scan
`sub bx, 0x257d`: the end pointer into the 0x247d row minus its start, the byte count copied at 0x2dbc

`mov di, 0x36dd`: the 0x28-byte bit row at 0x35dd (cleared by `lea di` at 0x36ac). Handed in di to leaf_loc_NOSG, which sets bits as `or byte [cs:bx + di], al`; a [bx + di] read names no single pointer register
